name: Projector with a Lenticular Mirror Sheet
definition: A projection-based multiview display using a projector and a reflective lenticular mirror sheet as the screen to direct reflected beams toward different viewing perspectives.
summary: A projection-based multiview display using a single projector and reflective lenticular mirror sheet to direct light toward different viewing perspectives, offering brighter images and simpler alignment than transmissive or multiprojector systems.
